boho.method: per row, the low frequencies (sigma 2) across x 379-419 replaced by a straight ramp from the wall at the band's left end (beside the bamboo light's ball, where no clean wall is left, the fill's own level) to the fill at its right end; fine grain kept, at the seam itself (x 395-403) the fill's grain from 8 px right; the light's pixels kept out

a_rim_echo.method: per column, the band 4-20 px above the new bowl's tanned rim (the bowl and its lip highlight kept) rebuilt as a straight fit in y of the clean bench front above it (from y 1146; fits smoothed over 4 columns), with those rows' own grain

b_bench_cushions.cushions: left (x 208-604, y 713-1012) and middle (x 906-1223, y 724-966), outlines along their frayed tops; the right one stays white (ours)
b_bench_cushions.target: sand linen ~ L 61 a 6 b 19 against the white cushion's L 71 a 4 b 12
b_bench_cushions.method: hand outlines along the frayed flange (feathered 2 px), terracotta / hat / moss / gaps cut out by colour; Lab shift only, so the crinkle texture and the shading stay

a_cups.outlines: three hand outlines (see cup_polys in the script), 2 px inside
a_cups.glaze: plain off-white: the cups' own a/b median, 3 b* cooler; the bowl keeps its speckle and tanned rim
a_cups.method: dots and the tanned rim line lifted to a 7 px closing of L*; a/b replaced by their 11 px median over the cup, b* -3; the form's shading kept

b_fly.method: the dark glyph (L 6 below the cushion ground, grown 2 px) inpainted from the ground round it (Telea r 4) with its grain

c_curtains.method: both curtains traced by hand (the plaster is the same colour as the linen); Lab shift of the mean 60 % toward the card, the folds' own L variation kept

wm.method: rings 5 and 6 replaced by ring 6 (side band and open bottom) scaled x1.25 about the axis to ring 5's size and hung under ring 4's rim; the ~20 px gap below and the leftover old ring pixels plain wall (harmonic + matched grain)

jar.method: Japandi A: the jar narrowed x0.76 about its axis (as ED4) redone from the original frame with a clean fill. Its outline: the     right edge (a strong gradient on every row) mirrored about the axis x 666, the rim (x 621-711, y 922-937) as measured, the base     rounded (y 1117-1129). The strips it leaves: the background shifted in along each structure's own slope, measured on its edges:     the top rail and glass horizontally (34 px), the garden and the upper rails at 0.41 / 0.44 px per px (34 px), the lower rails and     the sill's front edge at 0.53-0.55 (22-40 px). The branch stems in front of the rim are the original's. The old contact shadow is     taken out with the old base and a new one laid under the narrower base.
